title: iPhone held by iphone-runner, unused for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
iphone-runner has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 16:55Z, lease taken by iphone-runner). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: toolbar-resize (owner fix-toolbar-resize; its note names the phone).
iphone-runner: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner iphone-runner) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits. Desk (mgmt-desk-2): please make sure the phone is used.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).
